Class SavingGoal

java.lang.Object
com.duck.model.type.SavingGoal
public class SavingGoal extends Object
Represents a user-defined saving goal. Tracks the target amount, current progress, deadline, and the owning Account. Provides methods to check remaining amount and whether the goal is still active (not past deadline and not yet fully funded).
